news.title: SkillOpt: Agent skills as trainable parameters
news.summary_raw:
AI agents often fail because their instructions, or skills, are manually modified with no guarantee of improvement. Learn how SkillOpt turns skill editing into a training process, making agent behavior more reliable without changing model weights.
The post SkillOpt: Agent skills as trainable parameters appeared first on Microsoft Research.
news.summary: Microsoft Research has introduced SkillOpt, a system that trains agent skills as trainable parameters, making agent behavior more reliable. This addresses challenges in manually modifying agent instructions without guaranteeing improvement.
news.enterprise_use: Watch for SkillOpt's potential to apply similar concepts to improve the reliability of workflows managed by IT engineers, such as conditionally executing scripts or configuring policies. Inaction might mean relying on manual edits that can introduce unintended behavior.

news.title: 57% of enterprises have watched AI agents be confidently wrong. The fix is an agentic context layer, but who has one?
news.summary_raw: An enterprise AI agent answers with total confidence, but the number is wrong. Nobody catches it until someone traces it back to a stale metric definition or a document the retrieval system never pulled. The model did not fail. The context it was given did.In the past six months, 57% of enterprises traced a confident but wrong AI agent answer to missing or inconsistent business context, and 31% said it happened more than once, according to a VB Pulse June 2026 survey of 101 qualified enterprises
news.summary: A recent survey found 57% of enterprises experienced AI agents confidently providing incorrect information due to lack of context, and 31% saw this happen more than once. To mitigate this, the surveyed companies suggested adopting an 'agentic context layer'.
news.enterprise_use: Note the importance of context in AI decision-making and consider how to incorporate this principle into your AI workflows, such as ensuring the availability of relevant and up-to-date business data in your systems.
